artworks.title: Achilles and Penthesilea
artworks.description: Exekias' black-figure amphora — the moment Achilles kills Penthesilea and, in the same blow, sees her face and loves her.

artworks.title: The Death of Ajax
artworks.description: Lévy's painting of Ajax fallen on his sword — the Aethiopis aftermath when the arms of Achilles were judged to Odysseus.
